title: Meta says it’ll probably delay its controversial new business terms again
hook_text: Meta just delayed its AI terms.
script:
Meta is pushing its controversial new business terms past November twentieth after facing immense pressure.
Publishers raised major concerns over how the company scrapes content for AI training.
Meta communications head Andy Stone announced the delay in a post on the platform X.
Stone stated the firm does not plan to implement policy changes without full industry consultation.
This marks the second time the implementation date has been pushed back following earlier publisher backlash.
Will publishers secure strict content opt outs before Meta finalizes these rules?
